title: Pure P.U.N.K.
summary: Pure P.U.N.K. combo and Synchro strategy, centered on Japanese traditional performing arts motifs and LP-fueled Psychic plays. Level 3 Tuners pay 600 LP to search archetype cards and perform Fusion or Synchro Summons, drawing bonus cards with P.U.N.K. JAM Extreme Session and climbing into Rank 8 P.U.N.K. JAM FEVER! and Level 11 Ukiyoe-P.U.N.K. Amazing Dragon.

summary.title: Starters & Setup
points: Noh-P.U.N.K. Ze Amin: Primary Normal Summon starter that pays 600 LP to search any P.U.N.K. monster from Deck to hand.
Noh-P.U.N.K. Foxy Tune & Noh-P.U.N.K. Ogre Dance: Level 8 discard enablers that Special Summon P.U.N.K. monsters from the Deck or search Ze Amin.
Ukiyoe-P.U.N.K. Sharakusai: Pays 600 LP to Fusion Summon Ukiyoe-P.U.N.K. Rising Carp on your turn and Synchro Summons during the opponent's turn.
Noh-P.U.N.K. Rising Scale: Banishes a P.U.N.K. card to summon itself, fetches or revives a P.U.N.K. monster, and flips high-ATK opposing threats face-down.

summary.title: Opening Play
steps: Normal Summon Noh-P.U.N.K. Ze Amin and pay 600 LP to search Noh-P.U.N.K. Foxy Tune.
Activate Noh-P.U.N.K. Foxy Tune, discarding itself and another card to Special Summon Noh-P.U.N.K. Deer Note from the Deck.
Synchro Summon P.U.N.K. JAM Dragon Drive using Ze Amin and Deer Note.
Trigger Deer Note as Chain Link 1 to revive a Level 8 P.U.N.K. from GY, and Dragon Drive as Chain Link 2 to pay 600 LP and search Joruri-P.U.N.K. Madame Spider.
Special Summon Madame Spider or use P.U.N.K. JAM Extreme Session to draw 2 cards from your LP payments.
Overlay or stack into P.U.N.K. JAM FEVER! or end on Joruri-P.U.N.K. Dangerous Gabu for monster negation and LP gain.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: P.U.N.K. JAM FEVER!: Rank 8 Xyz stacked directly on a P.U.N.K. Fusion or Synchro, providing monster effect negation and draws.
Ukiyoe-P.U.N.K. Amazing Dragon: Level 11 Synchro summoned on the opponent's turn via Sharakusai to bounce multiple opposing cards based on your Level 3 Psychic names.
P.U.N.K. JAM Dragon Drive: Level 8 Synchro searching any Level 3 Psychic and recurring from the GY when the opponent activates an effect.
Psychic End Punisher: Unaffected Level 11 boss capitalizing on all your 600 LP costs to gain devastating ATK.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: P.U.N.K. JAM Extreme Session: Field Spell providing two extra card draws per turn whenever a Psychic monster pays LP, plus a Special Summon from hand.
Joruri-P.U.N.K. Dangerous Gabu: Searchable Normal Trap that negates an opponent's Effect Monster and gains LP equal to its ATK.
Joruri-P.U.N.K. Nashiwari Surprise: Target destruction trap that pops an additional face-up card if you control a P.U.N.K. monster.
